name: Ahd Al Ahrar
overview: After years away, Mohammed returns to his hometown in the valley with a radical vision he is determined to impose, igniting a bloody clash between loyalty to tradition and betrayal of heritage. As he sways the youth, village elders rise against him in an epic confrontation blending action and human drama, turning the struggle into a test of survival against forced change.

trailers.title: اعلان رسمي مسلسل عهد الاحرار. المسيره.
